The Development

A new landmark on Hallandale Beach Boulevard

Set on a full city block, Oasis Hallandale brings together two elegant residential towers, walkable shops and dining, and creative office space — the first true mixed-use destination in Hallandale Beach. Residences look out over the city skyline, the Atlantic horizon, and the Gulfstream Park grounds nearby.

Designed by Arquitectonica, the towers welcome residents home through a dramatic arrival sequence of fountains, lush vertical gardens, and a six-level cascading water feature — the signature of the Oasis experience.

Residences

A lifestyle beyond the ordinary

One, two, and three-bedroom flow-through floorplans bring the outdoors in through walls of glass. Choose your view — skyline, ocean, or the equestrian grounds of Gulfstream Park next door — then relax and entertain on a spacious private balcony.

The Kitchen

Every kitchen at Oasis Hallandale is finished with imported Italian cabinetry, a seamless one-piece countertop with integrated sink, and a full suite of stainless-steel appliances including a glass-top stove.

The West Tower is structurally topped out and nearing delivery; the East Tower is under active construction with availability now open.

The Primary Suite

Walk-in closets and uninterrupted glass walls framing the skyline or coastline.

The Bath

Frameless glass-enclosed showers, double sinks in master baths, and matching imported Italian tile and countertops.

The Living Room

Open-concept great rooms flow seamlessly onto broad glass-railed balconies, framing panoramic views of the skyline, the Atlantic, or the Gulfstream Park grounds below.

Six Levels of Amenities

Resort living, every day

Lush greenery, shade trees, water features, and far-reaching views run through every amenity level — designed so residents of every age can spend a weekend without ever leaving home.

Pools, sun & evenings outdoors

A palm-framed outdoor theater lawn anchors a deck built for long days by the water and easy evenings after — cabanas, fire pits, and a yoga lawn included. Residents and guests arrive home through a covered court framed by vertical gardens, leading to the six-level cascading waterfall at the heart of the property.

  • Two swimming pools

  • Indoor & outdoor movie theaters
